main_text.p: [ Perfecta Ecclesia, Canti.6.9. nempe imputatione perfectæ iustitiæ sponsi sui. Col.1 28. Perfecta lex & voluntas Dei, Rom.12.1.2. Iacob.1.25. perfecta Charitas, i.adimplerta, 1.Ioan.2.5. & 4.v.12.17.
Perfecta plebs i.edocta, bene instructa, Luc.1.17.
Perfectus Deus, Pater cælestis, Matth. 5, 48. homo 1 Tim.3.16.17. Iacob.1.4. & 3.2.] Opera Dei perfecta, Deut. 32.4.

Perfectus, pro eo qualem se hypocrita iactat, Matth.19. 21. verba enim illa Christi non in quo posita sit per se vita æterna declarant, sed huc spectant, ut hypocritam illum falsæ suæ iustitiæ spe deiectum redarguant. Perfectus est, qui est sicut Magister Christus, Luc.6.40. ad perfectionem exhortatio, Genes.17.1. Deuteron.18.13. Matth.5. 48.1 Cor.1.10. & 14.20.2. Corint.13 11. Ephes. 6.13.1. Petr. 1.13.
PERICVLVM piis non lethale, Exod.14.13. &c. V. Act.27. 22. &c. Marc.16.18.
PERIPSEMA omnium, Paulus, 1 Corinth. 4.13. (id est sordes.)

PERIVRIVM est, quando quis sciens & volens per iuramentum fallit, vel legitimum non seruat. Peierare enim est, vel rem falsam iurare, puta te non esse reum cædis cùm interfeceris: vel rem licitè iuratam non præstare.

PERIVRIVM: periurium prohibetur, Exod.20.7. Leuit.19.12. Deut.5.11. Matth.5.33. periurij & falsi crimen, Exod.8.v.15. 28. Leuit.5.4.1 Sam.19.6.1 Reg.8.31. Ier.7.9. Zach.5.3. Malach.3.5.1. Mach.6.62. & 7.v.15.18. & 11.53. & 13 ver.16.19. Machab.4.34. & 12.3. Matth.26.72.1 Tim.1.10. periurij poena, Malach.3.5. V.2 Sam.21.1. &c.

PERSECVTIONES ex Dei ignoratione, Ioann.16.3. à Satana excitantur, 8.44. Apoc.2.9. & 12.v.13 17. persecutionum vtilitas, Actor.8.4. & 11.20. Vide AFFLICTIONVM vtilitas. Persecutionis magnæ exemplum in Ecclesia Ierosolymitana Act.8.1. Persecutiones internæ interdum sunt: Exemplum in Isaac, Genes.21.9. Galat.4.29. Persecutionis piorum exempla: Cain persecutus est Abelem, Genes.4.8. Tyrannus Lothum in captiuitatem abductum, 14.12. Ismael Isaac cum, 21.9. Galat.4.29. Esau Iacobum, Genesis 27.v.42.4. Ægyptij Israelitas, Exod.14.8. Deut.26.6. Saul Dauidem 1 Sam.23.v.14.15.16. & 24.v.1.2.3. &c. 25.1. & 26.v.1.2.&c. Abalon

page.notes: Marginal notes at the right edge are cut off by the binding and too faint to transcribe. Several words in the text are doubtful due to print quality, notably the Latin in the line "Perfectus" and the final line with "Abalon", which may be "Absalon".
